note: Set A binds the section designations correctly (A4/D5/B1 = W10X15, roof beams = ø 3" openings) and keeps the 2"/6"/2" opening offsets attached to the right details, with only a couple of slips (calling the 2" offset a "top flange width", and putting the 2'-6" dimension on Detail C4, which actually shows 3'-7"/5'-3"/1'-8"; 2'-6" belongs to C1). Set B misassigns several values outright: B1 is labeled W8X13 (it is W10X15), E6 is labeled W10X15 (it is W8X13), 5'-0" is given to the grid 4 beam (it is on the grid 3 detail), 10'-0" is placed "near Grid 5" (it is on the grid 6 detail), and an 8" opening is claimed for E6, which only shows ø 3" openings. Set B also repeatedly invents a "between GRID 3 and GRID 4" condition that appears nowhere on the sheet and calls 10" opening widths "edge distance". A is clearly the more faithful set despite some vague entities.
